consequence.statement: Cilium keeps working, but the metric formerly emitted as `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_attempt` is emitted as `envoy_cilium_npds_update_attempt`, so dashboards, alerts or Prometheus rules referencing the old name will no longer match data until updated to the new name.
consequence.remediation: Update dashboards, alerts and Prometheus rules that reference `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_attempt` to use `envoy_cilium_npds_update_attempt`.

assertion.statement: In the Cilium 1.17 upgrade the metric `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_attempt` is renamed to `envoy_cilium_npds_update_attempt` (listed under "Changed Metrics" in the 1.17 Upgrade Notes).

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The changed item is an emitted Prometheus metric name (`envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_attempt`, renamed to `envoy_cilium_npds_update_attempt`); no supported subject family covers an emitted metric name.; applicability: Whether this matters depends on monitoring configuration (Prometheus rules, alerts, dashboards) referencing the old metric name `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_attempt`; no available predicate reads Prometheus/Grafana configuration and the change names no in-product setting, flag, values key or field, so no exposure predicate can be written.
